title: Tiefenbachklamm Kramsach
highlights: Spektakulaere Wildwasserschlucht der Brandenberger Ache zwischen Kramsach und Brandenberg
Gesicherter Felsensteig ueber Bruecken, Holzstege und schroffe Felsgalerien
Aussichtsplattform auf einer kuenen Konstruktion direkt ueber den tosenden Strudeln
Beliebtes Revier fuer erfahrene Wildwasserkajakfahrer und Naturbeobachter
kurzbeschreibung: The Tiefenbachklamm near Kramsach impresses with the roaring whirlpools of the Brandenberger Ache, rocky footbridges, and a spectacular viewing platform.
beschreibung:
Wild Waters and Untamed Rock Power

The Tiefenbachklamm is one of the most scenic gorges in the Tyrolean Unterinntal. Over millennia, the Brandenberger Ache has carved its way deep into the limestone, creating a narrow gorge full of rapids, waterfalls, and deep rock pools.

Spectacular Walkway and Dizzying Views

A well-maintained and secured path leads hikers for around four kilometers through the rocky gorge. The highlight is the viewing platform boldly cantilevered over the riverbed, offering an up-close perspective of the untamed force of the emerald-green whitewater.
